title: Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.


Requisitos e Perfil:


  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.


Diferenciais:


  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.


Sobre a UPX:


Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Gerente de Manutenção
description:
Procurando um desafio?


Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore. Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.


A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.



Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de Manutenção?

· Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Naval, Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica;

· Inglês avançado;

· Conhecimento e experiência em Gestão de Pessoas.



Responsabilidades:

· Colaborar na definição de estratégias da área de PPCM (Planejamento, Programação e Controle de Manutenção) alinhadas a necessidade da empresa.

· Aplicar ferramentas de controle e monitoramento das manutenções das embarcações, buscando mitigar os riscos e promovendo a confiabilidade e segurança operacional.

· Revisar e aprovar o planejamento de manutenção das grandes paradas realizadas pelo Coordenador de Manutenção.

· Monitorar e controlar os projetos de melhorias das suas embarcações.

· Liderar e avaliar o desempenho dos Coordenadores de Manutenção.

· Plano de saúde e odontológico, extensivo aos dependentes;

· Plataforma de cursos online para todos os colaboradores;

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis parceiro da Apolar Jardim Botânico é um profissional dinâmico e proativo, responsável pela comercialização de imóveis prontos (usados) e lançamentos em Curitiba e Região Metropolitana.

Como ter sucesso no cargo: O sucesso nesta função é impulsionado pela capacidade de entender e antecipar as necessidades dos clientes, oferecendo soluções imobiliárias que geram valor. Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. Profissionais que se destacam são aqueles que cultivam relações de confiança, dominam as técnicas de negociação, e mantêm-se atualizados sobre o mercado imobiliário e as condições de financiamento. A colaboração com a equipe e o alinhamento com os objetivos da franquia são diferenciais para alcançar o sucesso.

Responsabilidades
  • Angariar Imóveis: Identificar e angariar ativamente imóveis (usados e lançamentos) na região de Curitiba e Região Metropolitana, expandindo o portfólio da franquia e visando atingir a meta de 100 imóveis em carteira.
  • Gestão de Leads: Gerenciar e qualificar leads provenientes de diversas fontes (portais de anúncio, anúncios patrocinados, portal da Rede Apolar, LAIS), realizando o primeiro contato, acompanhamento e nutrição para convertê-los em clientes qualificados.
  • Uso de CRM: Determinar e desenvolver requisitos de usuários para sistemas em produção (Apolar Sales), garantindo o preenchimento completo e organizado de todas as informações de clientes, imóveis e interações, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado, compreendendo a real necessidade do cliente, apresentando as opções de imóveis mais adequadas e conduzindo visitas de forma eficaz.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Conduzir processos de negociação de compra e venda, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de contratos, garantindo a segurança e transparência em todas as etapas da transação.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe: Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de corretores, gerência e franqueados parceiros, compartilhando informações de mercado, estratégias e melhores práticas para otimização dos resultados coletivos.
  • Avaliação de Imóveis: Colaborar no processo de avaliação de imóveis quando solicitado, utilizando o conhecimento de mercado e, se certificado, o registro no CNAI.
  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado/a sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário de Curitiba, novas legislações, condições de financiamento e o perfil de cada bairro para oferecer um serviço consultivo de excelência.


Qualificações
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo. Curso superior, é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • Registro Profissional: Possuir registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (CRECI).
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia comprovada na comercialização de imóveis, com preferência para atuação em imóveis usados e/ou lançamentos.
  • Competências de Comunicação: Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e habilidade para se comunicar por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Habilidade Tecnológica: Familiaridade e disposição para utilizar ferramentas de CRM (Apolar Sales) e outras tecnologias para gestão de leads, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações.
  • Proatividade e Resiliência: Capacidade de agir com proatividade na busca por resultados e na angariação de imóveis, além de resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do mercado.
  • Orientação para o Cliente: Forte orientação para o cliente, com foco em entender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos de confiança e proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva.
  • Organização: Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes para manter registros precisos e acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Infraestrutura: Possuir carro, notebook, acesso à internet fora do escritório e celular para desempenho das atividades.

Para se candidatar entrar em contato através do e-mail: ou através do celular (WhatsApp) .

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.


  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

title: Network Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Network Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must have:

• Engineer or Technologist of systems or telecommunications, in computer science or related, with experience in management of local area networks (wired/wireless) for more 2000 virtual /physical devices and extended datacenter supporting critical business environments.

• Creation/Editing medium and high critical configuration scripts for new environments/ troubleshooting/ remediation scenario.

• Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

• Experience for configuration, troubleshooting, testing, IMAC for access/border/core network for Cisco/HP Family.

• This Family comprises small/medium switches L2/L3, small/medium/large Router L3-L7 for access/edge/core, WLAN Cisco/HP

• This CoE wants coverage firewalls Palo Alto, SASE - apply policies/rules/group member/individual

• Identification, testing and built cabling CAT5-9, fiberoptics MM/SM

• Testing for data communication radio & mobile access

• Knowledge for NSX /Virtualization network

• Active Directory/ Radius/802.1x/ MFA authentication.

• Palo Alto Firewall / Windows Jump Server configuration.

• Palo Alto VPN.

• Panorama and Cortex Management for large number of devices.

• Prepare, validate and conduct change Management process.

• Capacity/Performance analysis (CPU, Mem, throughput ports).

• Good Communication skills.

• Fluent in English and Portuguese

.

Good to have:

• Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

• Knowledge Fortinet/Huawei for network (LAN/WLAN) and security devices.

• Firewalls Paloalto and network security administration.

• Palo Alto Panorama and large number of firewall visibility and administration.

• Setup, configuration, integration, design, zero trust. Rules optimization, IP Policy and documentation

• Hardening, standard setup to prod preparation, capacity planning, high availability and failover

• Virtual and appliances devices, cloud and on prem, backup & Restore.

• VPN IPsec and Client to site implementation

• Integration with other security team members from threat intel, SOC

• Experience for EndUser support in record, diagnose and solve problems in the scope of microcomputing, hardware, operating systems, telephony, videoconferencing, web conferencing, audio conferencing and related areas, including performing any corrective maintenance on ICT equipment;

• Experience to clarify doubts and guide users regarding the use, availability, installation and configuration of software, applications, information systems (both those in the market and those developed internally), equipment, standards and procedures on the technological environment of the Customer and its use

• Identify and immediately report to the Level 2 Service Supervisor critical problems that have significant impacts on the technological environment of Customer, exceptional situations and other situations beyond its control or jurisdiction.

• Perform analysis of the hardware requirements for software installation.

• Test functionalities of new equipment, components or peripherals, and prepare configuration and user guides or manuals;

• Act in the execution of activities of the asset management process in Customer locations where there are no asset technicians allocated, at times when the Asset Management service is not available or whenever required by supervision.

• Understand cybersecurity attacks, mitigation methods.

Key responsibilities:

The network Associate is responsible for the LAN, WAN, WLAN or SDWAN Network. On LANs, WANs, WLANs, SDWANs, it is responsible for addressing, switches, routers, WiFi related devices, AD, DNS, NPM, Firewalls, CDN's, Balancers, NFV. In the WAN he is responsible for private networks and the Internet, and assists in the adoption of monitoring and data collection tools in the network. Supports carrier trunking with the local network, and participate on complex Network Setups.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

title: Information Technology Procurement, Corp IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.


As a procurement associate at Corporate IT, you will be responsible for IT products procurement to support various business units. You will serve as the primary interface and act as process owner responsible for managing suppliers and internal customers. In this position, you will play a key role in procuring high-quality and cost-efficient supplies for the organization. You will follow procurement procedures, maintain an updated list of inventory and incoming IT purchases and supplies.

  • Following and enforcing the company's procurement policies and procedures
  • Managing inventories and maintaining accurate purchase and pricing records.
  • Maintaining and updating supplier information such as qualifications, delivery times, product range.

  • To source, negotiate and establish purchases for IT goods and services

  • Knowledge of commercial relationship build-up and procurement techniques/process
  • Experience in negotiations and networking
  • Strong analytical skill, accurate and precise attention to details

  • Work experience in IT Suppliers/IT industry is added advantage
  • Initiative, enthusiasm and willingness to learn in a fluid and fast-paced environment
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively at all levels and with HQ Procurement team

title: Vendedor
description:
Missão do Cargo: 


Assegurar a reativação e fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes existentes da Viver Organizer, através de estratégias eficazes de acompanhamento e vendas, promovendo a fidelização e o aumento da receita da empresa.


Jornada de trabalho:

Presencial (44 horas semanais)

Segunda á Sexta-feira das 8:00 ás 17:48 com disponibilidade para acompanhar Lives e Eventos em horários alternativos e fins de semana, quando necessário


Regime de contratação: CLT 


Remuneração e Benefícios:

Salario Fixo R$2.500,00, +Comissão de 1% a 2% + Vale Alimentação (R$20,00 por dia em dinheiro), Vale Transporte


Principais Responsabilidades:


1. Identificar clientes adormecidos na base e desenvolver estratégias para reativar seu interesse nos produtos da empresa.

2. Realizar contato proativo com clientes através de telefonemas, e-mails, e outros meios de comunicação para reestabelecer o relacionamento.

3. Personalizar abordagens de vendas com base no histórico de compras e preferências dos clientes.

4. Criar e implementar campanhas de reativação e promoções direcionadas aos clientes adormecidos.

5. Acompanhar o ciclo de vida do cliente, desde a reativação até a fidelização, garantindo um atendimento personalizado.

6. Analisar e interpretar dados da planilha RFV (Recência, Frequência e Valor) para segmentação e priorização de clientes.

7. Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e análise de resultados das estratégias implementadas.

8. Colaborar com o time de marketing na criação de conteúdos e materiais promocionais voltados para clientes existentes.

9. Participar de reuniões estratégicas para discutir oportunidades de melhoria no relacionamento com clientes.

10. Manter-se atualizada sobre tendências e melhores práticas em retenção e fidelização de clientes.


Principais Atividades:

1. Realizar ligações telefônicas para clientes inativos para entender suas necessidades e motivos de inatividade.

2. Enviar e-mails personalizados com ofertas e conteúdos relevantes para reengajar clientes.

3. Atualizar informações e interações de clientes no sistema CRM da empresa.

4. Monitorar e responder feedbacks e solicitações de clientes de forma rápida e eficaz.

5. Organizar e participar de eventos e webinars voltados para clientes existentes.

6. Coletar e analisar feedbacks de clientes para melhorar produtos e serviços da empresa.

7. Desenvolver e implementar programas de fidelidade e benefícios para clientes recorrentes.

8. Criar e manter um calendário de comunicações regulares com clientes através de diferentes canais.

9. Treinar e orientar outros membros da equipe em técnicas de vendas e atendimento ao cliente.

10. Participar ativamente de iniciativas de cross-selling e upselling para clientes existentes.

11. Realizar follow-up consistente após o primeiro contato para manter o engajamento do cliente.

12. Identificar oportunidades de vendas adicionais com clientes reativados.

13. Preparar propostas comerciais personalizadas com base nas necessidades identificadas dos clientes.

14. Monitorar indicadores de performance de clientes reativados e propor ajustes estratégicos conforme necessário.

15. Colaborar com o time de suporte ao cliente para resolver questões e garantir a satisfação contínua.

16. Participar de eventos externos e feiras para fortalecer relacionamentos com clientes chave.

17. Desenvolver materiais educativos e de suporte para clientes sobre novos produtos ou atualizações.

18. Realizar benchmarking com concorrentes para identificar oportunidades de melhorias nas estratégias de retenção.

19. Implementar ações de marketing de boca a boca através de clientes satisfeitos e influenciadores.

20. Apresentar relatórios mensais de desempenho e recomendações para aprimorar a estratégia de retenção.

21. Conduzir pesquisas de satisfação periódicas com clientes para avaliar o nível de serviço e identificar áreas de melhoria.

22. Manter um registro detalhado de interações e histórico de compras de cada cliente no CRM.

23. Apoiar o desenvolvimento de conteúdo para redes sociais voltado para engajar clientes existentes.

24. Avaliar o potencial de clientes inativos para upselling de produtos premium ou serviços adicionais.

25. Participar de treinamentos contínuos para aprimorar habilidades técnicas e de relacionamento com clientes.


Competências Comportamentais:


* Excelente habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.

* Orientação para o cliente e foco em resultados.

* Capacidade de construir relacionamentos sólidos e de longo prazo.

* Empatia e sensibilidade para entender as necessidades dos clientes.

* Proatividade e iniciativa na resolução de problemas.

* Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente.

* Resiliência e habilidade para lidar com objeções e desafios.


Competências Técnicas:


* Ensino superior completo em áreas relacionadas, preferencialmente em Marketing, Administração ou Comunicação.

* Experiência prévia em vendas ou atendimento ao cliente, especialmente com foco em reativação de clientes.

* Conhecimento em sistemas CRM e ferramentas de automação de marketing.

* Cursos complementares em vendas, negociação, e gestão de relacionamento com clientes são desejáveis.


Competências Culturais:


* Comprometimento com a excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

* Alinhamento com os valores e missão da Viver Organizer.

* Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar efetivamente com diferentes áreas.

* Adaptabilidade a um ambiente dinâmico e orientado para resultados.


Competências Comportamentais Necessárias:


* Alta capacidade de escuta ativa e empatia.

* Visão estratégica e capacidade analítica.

* Integridade e ética profissional.

* Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com iniciativa própria.

* Mentalidade orientada para soluções e oportunidades de crescimento.


O que esperamos de você?

Honestidade acima de tudo, caráter, amor pelo que faz, humildade para aprender, e vontade de inovar e melhorar sempre!

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.


The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.


Key Responsibilities


1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively


2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.


3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.


4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.


5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.


6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.


7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).


Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Fund Manager
description:
Fund Operations Manager (AMIF)

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - On site

Company: Amicorp Fund Services


Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.


About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.


Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.


✨ Ready to elevate your career and lead with impact?

Apply now and become part of Amicorp’s global success sto

Este/a profissional garantirá a correta gestão dos contratos em projetos de construção civil, assegurando conformidade legal, mitigação de riscos e maximização de resultados financeiros , tendo estas principais atribuições:


  • Analisar e interpretar contratos de obras e serviços, identificando riscos e oportunidades;
  • Acompanhar a execução contratual, propondo medidas corretivas e preventivas;
  • Elaborar notificações, aditivos, termos de encerramento e demais documentos contratuais;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de obras na gestão de escopo, prazos, custos e compliance contratual;
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes, fornecedores e subcontratados para alinhamento contratual;
  • Realizar interface com o jurídico para suporte em disputas, mediações e arbitragens;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e legais, incluindo cláusulas de compliance, seguros, garantias e licenças;
  • Utilizar corretamente a documentação que integra a concorrência (carta convite, edital de licitação, perguntas/consultas, leis de contratação pública, etc.) durante a etapa de conquista;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de todos os deveres e obrigações contratuais, com amplo domínio dos documentos envolvidos (contrato, proposta técnica/econômica, aditivos, leis, normas, seguros e fianças);
  • Elaborar, em conjunto com outras áreas, documentação contratual robusta (cartas, e-mails, diários de obra, relatórios, cronogramas, etc.), respeitando os parâmetros e prazos contratuais e mantendo o arquivo do projeto organizado;
  • Quando cabível, elaborar e sustentar reivindicações (claims) e aditivos junto ao cliente, preservando o equilíbrio contratual.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Contratos, Direito Contratual ou Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Experiência em projetos de infraestrutura pesada e/ou obras industriais na área de Administração Contratual;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos da Legislação aplicável (Lei de Licitações, Contratos Privados, Normas Técnicas);
  • Forte habilidade de negociação, comunicação clara e visão analítica;
  • Dominar as diversas estruturas de modalidades contratuais utilizadas nos mercados mais competitivos mundialmente (Preços Unitários, preço global, LSTK, Aliança, EPCM, entre outros.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players . Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and other international markets.

We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. If you are eager to learn, unafraid of challenges, and ready to grow with a like-minded team — we want to hear from you.


Role


As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and deployment of products that help companies engage with their customers in efficient and personal ways.

Our technology stack is built in Scala, NodeJS, and Ruby on Rails, running on Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Kafka. We containerize and deploy with Kubernetes on AWS. You will be responsible for service delivery, reliability, scalability, monitoring, and helping define all this as immutable infrastructure-as-code.


Responsibilities


  • Deploy and maintain critical applications on cloud-native microservices architecture.
  • Implement automation, effective monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Deploy and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
  • Support and work alongside a cross-functional engineering team on the latest technologies.
  • Iterate on best practices to increase the quality & velocity of deployments.
  • Sustain and improve the process of knowledge sharing throughout the engineering team.


Requirements


  • Experience deploying and maintaining scalable, resilient and highly available systems in cloud environments.
  • Skills in automation of repetitive tasks (scripting via Bash, Python, Ruby).
  • Practical experience with Docker containerization and clustering (Kubernetes, ECS, Rancher).
  • Expertise with AWS (e.g., IAM, EC2, VPC, ELB, ALB, Autoscaling, Lambda).
  • Experience with version control system (e.g., Git, Gitlab).
  • Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.


Working with us implies


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


O que você deve ter?


- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Merchant Onboarding Analyst（Shift Position）

title: Sales Consultant
description:
About Us

Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.


We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.


Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!


Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.


Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.


We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:


  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.


Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!


What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.


Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.


Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).


Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.


Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.


Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!


Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.


We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world’s leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called “Cognoids,” take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their ‘Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast’ culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.


Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager’s territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.


Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

title: Analista Supply Chain
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.


Objetivo do Cargo:


O(a) Analista de Supply III será responsável por liderar iniciativas em toda a cadeia de Procure-to-Pay dentro do setor de Oil & Gas, garantindo processos de aquisição eficientes, compliance regulatório e geração de valor por meio da negociação, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e identificação de oportunidades de savings. Atuará de forma transversal, conectando-se com clientes internos, auditoria, análise de custos e estratégia de suprimentos, com foco em excelência operacional, sustentabilidade da cadeia e alinhamento às metas organizacionais.



Responsabilidades


Procura & Negociação:


  • Liderar processos de Procura para categorias definidas, conduzindo análises de mercado, RFPs, RFQs e negociações complexas, incluindo elaboração de Ordens de Compra de acordo com os termos e condições acordados.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, garantindo performance, entregas no prazo, inovação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de savings, por meio da análise de gastos, otimizando custos e promovendo eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Implementar contratos e SLAs alinhados às políticas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio.


Análise & Gestão de Performance:


  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.
  • Gerenciar dados de procura e gastos, identificando tendências, oportunidades de savings e alavancas de negociação.
  • Garantir a qualidade das informações em sistemas de gestão (ERP, tracking e dashboards de performance).
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.


Stakeholder Management & Comunicação:


  • Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas clientes para definição de prioridades e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Fornecer suporte em processos de auditoria externa e interna relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos.


Liderança & Desenvolvimento:


  • Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.
  • Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.



Requisitos


Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement ou Supply Chain dentro do setor de Oil & Gás.
  • Forte conhecimento em negociação, gestão de contratos e análise financeira.
  • Domínio de ERP (preferencialmente JDE ou Oracle) e ferramentas analíticas (Excel avançado, Power BI).
  • Inglês fluente.



Desejáveis:


  • Certificações (CPSM, CSCP, CFA ou similares).
  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
  • Vivência em empresas globais e ambientes multiculturais.
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de estoques.



Competências & Habilidades:


  • Visão estratégica aliada à execução tática.
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Habilidade de negociação e influência em diferentes níveis.
  • Organização, gestão de múltiplas prioridades e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Comunicação clara, assertiva e foco em relacionamento colaborativo.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão.

NOSSA EMPRESA

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.

Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).

Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

#VemSerAgropalma

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.


Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.
