title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information
The Team
Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Testing and commissioning Engineer to join our dynamic team for Data Center projects in Brazil. This position demands a solid foundation in electrical engineering, particularly in testing and Commissioning power generation equipment. The ideal candidate will ensure that all equipment and systems adhere to Industry standards and regulatory requirements through thorough and safe testing processes. Responsibilities will encompass managing all aspects of testing, including Factory acceptance Tests (FAT), Site acceptance Tests (Sat), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). The engineer should be proficient in developing and executing test plans That align with customer needs while maintaining clear communication with the factory.


Key responsibilities:

  • Actual participation in testing and commissioning activities including FAT, SAT, and IST;
  • Ensure adherence to industry regulations and safety standards during testing and commissioning processes;
  • Develop and implement testing protocols to validate system functionality and performance according to customer specificity;
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to testing and commissioning;
  • Collaborate with project teams to incorporate testing and commissioning activities into overall project plans;
  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred;
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning power generator preferred;
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical testing and commissioning (E.g., IEEE, IEC, NEC);
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and capacity to analyze complex electrical systems;
  • Experience in project management or coordination is a plus;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team;
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality;
  • This position may require travel to project sites or customer locations, both locally and internationally as needed.

*Please note that this is a 1 year renewable contract position*

Buscamos um profissional estruturado, curioso e ativo, com mentalidade voltada à execução organizada e ao apoio estratégico, que atue como ponte entre o planejamento comercial e a operação — garantindo que os processos estejam claros, aplicáveis e sempre em evolução.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Documentar e padronizar processos comerciais, criando materiais que sirvam como base para treinamentos da equipe de vendas.


  • Apoiar a construção da jornada de vendas e garantir que as etapas estejam registradas e atualizadas.


  • Desenvolver e manter relatórios e no Excel (nível intermediário), com foco em indicadores de desempenho comercial.


  • Cumprir prazos e atividades com autonomia, responsabilidade e atenção a detalhes.


  • Participar ativamente das rotinas do time, propondo melhorias e soluções práticas para desafios operacionais e de execução.


  • Auxiliar na organização de playbooks, roteiros, fluxo de processos em geral, materiais de apoio e cronogramas de treinamentos comerciais.


Competências Comportamentais Esperadas
  • Curiosidade: Busca constante por entender o "porquê" das coisas e interesse genuíno por aprender e evoluir nos temas comerciais.


  • Organização: Capacidade de manter processos estruturados, claros e replicáveis.


  • Planejamento: Perfil com mentalidade estratégica e habilidade para montar cronogramas, documentações e acompanhar execução.


  • Responsabilidade: Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade.


  • Proatividade: Apresentar ideias, soluções e iniciativas que contribuam com a melhoria contínua do time.

title: Cross-border Customs Operations
description:
Location: São Paulo, Brazil


Responsibilities:

1. Manage and oversee the logistics and customs clearance processes of platform products from China to Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian laws and regulations.

2. Coordinate relationships with Brazilian customs, logistics providers, and government agencies to enhance clearance quality and efficiency.

3. Track changes in customs policies and regulations in the Brazilian market to ensure compliance and forward-thinking business operations.

4. Address issues in cross-border e-commerce clearance operations such as inspections, timeliness, customer complaints, and key processes.

5. Develop and execute strategies to optimize tariffs and logistics costs, improving AliExpress's competitiveness in the Brazilian market.

6. Provide training in cross-border customs matters to enhance the professional capabilities of team members.


Localização: São Paulo, Brasil


Responsabilidades:

1. Gerir e supervisionar os processos logísticos e de desalfandegamento de produtos da plataforma da China para o Brasil, garantindo conformidade com as leis e regulamentos brasileiros.

2. Coordenar relações com a alfândega brasileira, fornecedores logísticos e agências governamentais para melhorar a qualidade e eficiência do desalfandegamento.

3. Acompanhar as mudanças nas políticas e regulamentos aduaneiros no mercado brasileiro para assegurar a conformidade e operações comerciais com visão de futuro.

4. Resolver problemas na operação de desalfandegamento do comércio eletrônico transfronteiriço como inspeções, prazos, reclamações de clientes e processos chave.

5. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para otimizar tarifas e custos logísticos, aumentando a competitividade do AliExpress no mercado brasileiro.

6. Oferecer treinamento em assuntos aduaneiros transfronteiriços para melhorar as capacidades profissionais dos membros da equipe.



Requirements:


1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above in international trade, logistics management, e-commerce, or related fields.


2. Experience:

◦ At least 3 years of experience in cross-border e-commerce and customs management.

◦ Experience operating e-commerce platforms in Brazil preferred.


3. Skills:

◦ Familiar with and proficient in customs processes between Brazil and China, and platform operation standards.

◦ Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of negotiating in various complex situations.

◦ Strong analytical skills for problem location and project management; ability to proactively optimize and implement solutions.

◦ Proficient in using relevant customs management software and e-commerce platform tools.


4. Language:

◦ Fluent in Portuguese with excellent written and spoken capabilities.

◦ Fluent in English; Mandarin skills preferred.


5. Other Requirements:

◦ Strong sense of responsibility and attention to business details.

◦ Adapt to rapidly changing international e-commerce environment and actively promote ongoing business development.


Requisitos:


1. Educação: Bacharelado ou superior em comércio internacional, gestão logística, comércio eletrônico ou áreas afins.


2. Experiência:

◦ Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em comércio eletrônico transfronteiriço e gestão aduaneira.

◦ Experiência operando plataformas de comércio eletrônico no Brasil preferida.


3. Habilidades:

◦ Familiaridade e proficiência nos processos aduaneiros entre Brasil e China, e normas de operação de plataforma.

◦ Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, capaz de negociar em várias situações complexas.

◦ Fortes habilidades analíticas para localização de problemas e gerenciamento de projetos; capacidade de otimizar e implementar soluções proativamente.

◦ Proficiente em usar software de gestão aduaneira relevante e ferramentas de plataforma de comércio eletrônico.


4. Idioma:

◦ Fluente em português, com excelentes habilidades de escrita e fala.

◦ Fluente em inglês; habilidades em mandarim são preferidas.


5. Outros Requisitos:

◦ Forte senso de responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes do negócio.

◦ Adaptar-se a um ambiente de comércio eletrônico internacional em rápida mudança e promover ativamente o desenvolvimento contínuo dos negócios.

title: Técnico de Manutenção Predial
description:
RESUMO DO TRABALHO:

Realiza tarefas técnicas, elétricas e mecânicas, incluindo instalação, reparo, manutenção preventiva, solução de problemas e melhorias de processos em instalações existentes e futuras. Além disso, o técnico de manutenção trabalhará na conservação das áreas externas, áreas comuns e áreas de produção para manter o padrão da empresa de ambientes limpos e seguros.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Trabalhar com o Gerente de Manutenção para desenvolver cronogramas padrão de manutenção preventiva.

• Operar, reparar e manter equipamentos de produção, equipamentos de movimentação de materiais, sistemas elétricos e mecânicos, incluindo, mas não limitado a sistemas e equipamentos de sprinklers contra incêndio.

• Substituir peças defeituosas como engrenagens, embreagens, buchas, eixos, rolamentos, solenóides, válvulas, bombas, controles de direção, etc.

• Executar manutenção de rotina em todas as máquinas da planta e demais áreas do prédio e da propriedade conforme instruções do gerente de operações.

• Executar corretamente os procedimentos de Bloqueio e Etiquetagem (Lockout Tagout) e manter atenção constante à segurança.

• Utilizar ferramentas elétricas e manuais para realizar diversas tarefas, incluindo reparo de máquinas, montagem de tubulação, manutenção elétrica e eletrônica.

• Operar empilhadeiras, carrinhos e outros equipamentos básicos de carga e descarga, quando necessário.

• Fazer a lubrificação, engraxamento e abastecimento dos equipamentos conforme necessário.

• Completar procedimentos rotineiros de manutenção preventiva conforme estabelecido no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoiar programas de redução de custos e controle de despesas, priorizando consertar ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdícios de materiais e suprimentos, e utilizando corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos.


CONHECIMENTOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES BÁSICAS:

• Capacidade comprovada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para identificar e corrigir problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz.

• Habilidade para operar equipamentos básicos de escritório como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de postagem e sistemas telefônicos multilinha.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.


EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Deve ser capaz de ficar em pé, caminhar e/ou sentar por longos períodos, além de dobrar-se, agachar, subir escadas, alcançar, carregar objetos e rastejar em áreas confinadas.

• Deve ter capacidade para trabalhar em áreas internas e externas em todas as condições climáticas (chuva, neve, calor, granizo, vento e gelo).

• Deve ser capaz de empurrar, puxar, levantar, carregar ou manusear pesos de até 11 kg sozinho e até 23 kg com ajuda.

• Deve ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo sobreaviso durante noites, fins de semana e feriados.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Supervisão e liderança da equipe de operações e manutenção, garantindo eficiência e produtividade;
  • Assegurar o bom funcionamento de todas as áreas operacionais do shopping e implementar melhorias quando necessário;
  • Administração das finanças condominiais, incluindo gestão do caixa, despesas, arrecadação e monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Colaboração com o departamento comercial para alinhar estratégias de arrecadação e otimização de receitas;
  • Elaboração e acompanhamento do orçamento condominial, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros;
  • Administração das despesas relacionadas a utilidades, como água, energia e gás, e distribuição equitativa entre os condôminos;
  • Manutenção e organização de documentos do shopping e elaboração do orçamento de NOI para análise de desempenho financeiro;
  • Monitoramento e controle de custos operacionais, acompanhamento da receita e análise dos resultados financeiros;
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento de processos internos e auditorias;
  • Análise de indicadores técnicos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e uso de software especializado para gestão da manutenção.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Mecânica ou Elétrica;
  • Experiência em Obras, Manutenção e Infraestrutura;
  • Vivência com controle orçamentário;
  • Experiência com gestão de equipe.


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Analista de Business Development
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 6.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil


about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.


job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients


Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

Requirements


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations
  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account’s objectives and the client’s initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.
  • Must be fluent in English.


This position will require a live SQL Assessment.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externa - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.


Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.


Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.


Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora, são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • Primam pela excelência na execução como forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem um ambiente inclusivo e um bom clima tanto para as pessoas que trabalham no Meli como para o negócio.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar na região de Guarulhos - SP.


O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

Você equilibra planejamento com ações. Você pesquisa iniciativas e tenta novas abordagens. Você se mantém alinhado com seus objetivos e se mantém produtivo. Você solicita contribuições e discussões. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Business Operations Associate


São Paulo, Brazil

About Divibank:


At Divibank, we are developing the leading platform for online businesses in Latin America, combining

payment solutions and access to capital. With our payment orchestration solution, we integrate multiple

payment methods to our subacquirer, helping businesses increase transaction approvals and improve

their sales by up to 22%, reduce costs and drive sustainable growth. Our mission is to be the go-to

partner for companies looking to expand efficiently, offering technology and personalized support in an

all-in-one platform.


This is a PJ hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in our office on Av Brigadeiro Faria Lima 1912.


About the role and team:

We are looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our dynamic team.

You will have the opportunity to drive the success of businesses in Brazil and play a critical role in

ensuring smooth operational processes, providing exceptional customer support, and fostering strong

relationships with our clients. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and driven by

problem-solving. Our operations and customer success teams are the tip of the spear of our business,

with agile thinking and excellent communication to drive positive change for our customers.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the processes of proposal generation, KYC (Know Your Customer), and client

onboarding, ensuring agility and clear communication with all relevant teams.

  • Act as the main point of contact for customers, ensuring an efficient onboarding process,

addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive customer experience.

  • Oversee customer support operations using CX tools to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets

quickly, delivering an exceptional customer experience that conveys trust and reliability.

  • Monitor transaction data and chargebacks, quickly identifying fraud risks and implementing

corrective actions.

  • Handle chargeback response cases, supporting clients to timely respond with the necessary

information.

  • Work together with our Treasury to ensure client settlements are working according to plan.
  • Run credit card receivable assignment operations, either for discounting or for collection

purposes.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to payment

operations.

  • Map and review operational workflows and data to identify gaps and propose improvements,

whether through process adjustments, the implementation of third-party tools, or development

suggestions for internal product and tech teams.

  • Collaborate with technology and product teams to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in

a timely manner.

  • Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs and ensure their satisfaction with

our services.

  • Work closely with the sales and product teams to align customer success initiatives to optimize

customer journey

  • Track and report customer success metrics, including satisfaction rates, retention, and churn.


What qualifications we need:

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, customer success, or a related role, preferably within the

fintech, payments or consulting industries.

  • Bachelor’s degree (completed or in progress) in relevant fields (Business Administration,

Engineering, etc.).

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) and operations tools.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and business orientation
  • Positive, willing to get hands dirty and proactive attitude
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize in ambiguous situations
  • Working proficiency and communication skills in English (verbal and written)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience in Fintech or online Payments industry
  • Basic understanding of APIs or technical architecture to collaborate effectively with engineers
  • Knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Looker.


Personal attitudes we look for:

  • You get sh*t done!
  • You do whatever it takes to get things moving and completed
  • You have an ownership mentality, are energetic, and bring the best out of others
  • You communicate clearly and concisely
  • You can adapt and explain complex subjects to different audiences
  • Everyone understands what your priorities and objectives are
  • You organize and break down complex problems into simple tasks
  • You can think structurally and identify bottlenecks
  • You balance and align your short and long-term priorities with Divibank’s goals
  • You are curious and have a growth mindset
  • You are always learning and growing (even outside of work)
  • You take risks, learn from failures quickly and apply lessons learned
  • You are quietly confident and openly humble
  • You are confident in your abilities, and are not afraid to step up when needed
  • You respect the backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking of others


Key Benefits:

  • Amil Health and dental insurances
  • Competitive salary
  • Chance of earning equity at Divibank
  • Flexible paid vacation
  • Totalpass

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

Com uma equipe líder do setor composta por especialistas internos em energia, somos uma subsidiária integral da Canadian Solar Inc. e atuamos como o braço global da Canadian Solar para desenvolvimento e serviços de energia.

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.

  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Process Engineer - Liquids
description:
JOB SUMMARY

As part of the Process Engineering team you are responsible for the engineering process of refining, fat modification and oleochemical plants.


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Design and calculate the refining, fat modification and/or oleochemical process of sold projects based on contractual and customer specifications, and on Desmet standards

and best practices.

  • Size and specify the required equipment.
  • Produce and compile related engineering documents (basic PFD, heat & mass balances,

utilities & consumptions, P&ID’s, operating manuals, description of automation, HAZOP

studies, …).

  • Perform plant start-up and commissioning activities and carry-out troubleshooting.
  • Gather and report site technical data and experience to improve our products and processes.
  • Improve existing processes and equipment.
  • Participate in and support R&D activities and projects: perform feasibility studies and

contribute to the development of new designs.

  • Give internal support and assist customers regarding health & safety issues, environmental

aspects, permits,…


REQUIRED PROFILE

Required Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical or Bio engineering).
  • 2-5 years of experience in an engineering department or company in process industry.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Special interest for processes and Unit Operations.
  • Pro-active and self-driven attitude, able to prioritize & meet deadlines.
  • Accurate and work organized.
  • Team player, sharing essential information.
  • Sufficiently analytical for trouble solving
  • Willingness to travel for short periods, representing our company.
  • English and/or Spanish preferred (strong asset), and any other language is an asset.


OUR OFFER


You will join a global market leader in an international environment with highly talented colleagues. We’ll offer you a fulltime position with an attractive compensation package with good benefits and the opportunity to grow and develop in your skills, competencies, and career.

Apply now with CV and short motivation:

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior & Líder Técnico
description:
Descrição da Vaga: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior & Líder Técnico

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior com fortes habilidades de liderança técnica para integrar uma equipe internacional de desenvolvimento. Este profissional será responsável por liderar a concepção e implementação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e eficientes, atuando em ambas as camadas (front-end e back-end), além de mentorar outros desenvolvedores e apoiar práticas ágeis de desenvolvimento.

Esta é uma oportunidade desafiadora para quem busca atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com tecnologia de ponta e alto impacto técnico e estratégico.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar novas funcionalidades em sistemas front-end e back-end utilizando tecnologias modernas de desenvolvimento web.
  • Analisar sistemas existentes, definir requisitos de integração e propor melhorias técnicas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais (desenvolvimento, arquitetura, DevOps, produto) para garantir a entrega eficaz de soluções.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurar a qualidade do software e orientar membros juniores da equipe.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis (como sprint planning, daily meetings, retrospectives) e alinhar entregas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Investigar e resolver problemas complexos que afetam sistemas em larga escala, propondo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis.



Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência relevante com desenvolvimento de software.
  • Stack obrigatória: C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core Web API + Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS .
  • Experiência avançada com Entity Framework , Microsoft SQL Server e ajuste de desempenho de consultas e bancos de dados.
  • Conhecimento profundo em microsserviços , arquitetura orientada a eventos e padrões de projeto (ex: Saga).
  • Experiência com Docker ou Kubernetes , pipelines de CI/CD e ferramentas como Azure DevOps ou equivalentes.
  • Habilidade comprovada em liderar equipes de desenvolvimento, facilitar práticas ágeis e interagir com arquitetos de solução.
  • Inglês avançado para reports a times estrangeiros.
  • Capacidade de atuar como líder técnico e Scrum Master simultaneamente.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido em São Paulo, SP.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e padrões de mensageria assíncrona (ex: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento em IIS , serviços Microsoft Azure e arquitetura de sistemas corporativos.
  • Atuação prévia em domínios de negócio complexos, como commodity trading , finanças ou logística, será considerado um diferencial.


O que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente internacional com alto padrão técnico.
  • Trabalho remoto com flexibilidade de horários.
  • Integração com equipes globais e projetos de grande escala.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com foco em inovação, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia de software.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning . The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.


Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”).
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.


*Best to have experience in fundraising, development, or a similar role, preferably in an educational or nonprofit environment. Ideally this person would understand the Brazilian Government bureaucracy regarding “Leis de incentivo”

Os membros do nosso time são chamados de Helper's, pois estão empenhados em fazer a diferença e promover a liberdade na vida das pessoas. Valorizamos profundamente esse compromisso, e se você compartilha desse propósito, ficaremos extremamente felizes em tê-lo conosco.

title: Finance Planning Analyst
description:
About the Company


Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.


Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.


Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.


About the Role


Financial Planning and Budgeting

  • Support the annual budgeting process by collaborating with department heads to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
  • Develop multi-scenario budget models to evaluate different business outcomes and their financial implications.
  • Consolidate data into the overall business plan, ensuring accuracy and consistency across departments.


Forecasting

  • Prepare monthly forecasts to provide management with an updated view of expected performance.
  • Continuously refine forecasting methodologies based on actual results, new market information, or changes in business conditions.
  • Collaborate with other teams to anticipate deviations and incorporate business insights into updated forecasts.


Financial Analysis and Performance Tracking

  • Perform detailed variance analyses (actual vs. budget, forecast vs. prior period) to identify key drivers of deviations in revenue, cost, and profitability.
  • Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and ratios to provide actionable insights to management.
  • Translate financial data into clear business narratives, highlighting risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.


Management Reporting

  • Prepare monthly management reports and executive dashboards summarizing financial performance and business trends.
  • Support the preparation of internal presentations with accurate and insightful financial data.
  • Develop automated reporting tools and dashboards to enhance transparency and reduce manual processes.


Strategic and Decision Support

  • Provide financial modeling and scenario analysis to support strategic initiatives.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis requests from management, including profitability studies and ROI evaluations.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to quantify the financial impact of operational decisions and support data-driven planning.


Cash Flow and Capital Planning

  • Monitor cash flow projections and funding requirements to ensure liquidity for ongoing operations and investments.
  • Support Treasury and Finance teams in capital allocation decisions and debt planning when required.


Process Improvement and Control

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve FP&A processes, models, and tools to increase efficiency and accuracy.
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency between FP&A models, ERP systems, and accounting records.
  • Support internal control efforts related to financial planning, forecasting, and reporting.


Requeriments


  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English, equivalent to CEFR B2 or above.
  • Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2 - 4 years of experience in FP&A, Treasury, Controllership or related roles.
  • Strong analytical ability to manage and evaluate complex data
  • Knowledge of financial modelling
  • Experience in financial forecasting and analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow)
  • Strong communication skills to proactively interact with various business stakeholders
  • Advanced skills in the Microsoft Office Excel.
  • Excellent attention to detail, with good organizational and multitasking skills.

title: Interpreter / Translator
description:
About Netcracker


Netcracker Technology, a subsidiary of NEC Corporation, is a global provider of BSS, OSS, and cloud solutions for the telecom industry. Our innovative software and professional services help leading communication service providers transform their operations and deliver digital experiences worldwide.


About the Role


We are seeking a full-time Interpreter/Translator to support our multinational business and project teams in Brazil. This role will provide simultaneous and written translation between English and Portuguese, helping ensure clear communication across global teams and business units. The ideal candidate is accurate, professional, and comfortable supporting meetings and documents involving technical and business terminology.


Key Responsibilities


  • Provide real-time interpretation (English–Portuguese and Portuguese–English) during meetings, workshops, and project discussions.
  • Translate business documents, emails, and presentations for internal and external audiences.
  • Support project teams by ensuring messages are accurately and contextually communicated across languages.
  • Collaborate with business and technical leaders to align on terminology and tone.
  • Review, edit, and proofread translations for clarity, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Handle sensitive or confidential information with discretion.
  • Adapt communication style for different audiences (technical, business, executive).


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Translation, Languages, Communication, or a related field.
  • Local natural Portuguese speaker with fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Proven experience as a professional translator/interpreter, ideally in an international or corporate environment.
  • Strong understanding of business and technical terminology.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in IT or Telecommunications environments.
  • Experience supporting multinational teams or projects.
  • Other language skills are an advantage.


What We Offer


  • CLT employment with competitive compensation and full benefits.
  • The opportunity to work with a multicultural and global team.
  • Exposure to innovative technology projects and international business environments.
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities within a leading global IT company.

A pessoa que ocupar esta função será responsável por oferecer suporte administrativo e operacional a diferentes áreas da organização, garantindo que as atividades do dia a dia fluam de forma eficiente e organizada. Atuará como ponto de apoio entre a equipe, a direção e o público externo, contribuindo para o bom andamento das rotinas e o alcance dos objetivos institucionais.

Para ter sucesso nesta posição, é essencial demonstrar proatividade, discrição, atenção aos detalhes e excelente capacidade de comunicação. A pessoa ideal saberá priorizar demandas, manter a confidencialidade de informações estratégicas e apresentar postura colaborativa. O sucesso será medido pela capacidade de manter a estrutura administrativa fluindo de forma organizada e pelo apoio efetivo às lideranças e equipes.

A função de Secretária Administrativa é fundamental para a integração dos processos internos, servindo como elo entre diferentes setores. Essa posição garante a eficiência das operações diárias e contribui diretamente para que a gestão mantenha foco nas decisões estratégicas, sabendo que as rotinas administrativas estão sob controle.

  • Gerenciar agendas, compromissos e reuniões, assegurando organização e pontualidade.

  • Apoiar o controle de despesas, elaboração de relatórios e acompanhamento de pagamentos.

  • Apoiar processos de recrutamento, integração de novos colaboradores e gestão de registros administrativos.
  • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações e pelo cumprimento das políticas internas da organização.

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Administração, Secretariado Executivo ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em funções administrativas ou de secretariado.
  • Domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e ferramentas de comunicação digital.
  • Competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com atenção à clareza e à formalidade adequada.
  • Capacidade de organização, planejamento e gestão do tempo.
  • Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente e resolver problemas de forma autônoma.

title: Professor(a) Assistente Bilíngue - Ensino Fundamental I
description:

O(a) profissional selecionado(a) prestará assistência ao Professor em suas atividades educacionais e na aplicação do conteúdo pedagógico programado, além de criar um vínculo positivo com os alunos para garantir o melhor aproveitamento do planejamento previsto.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Recepcionar os alunos quando da sua chegada à Escola.
  • Auxiliar o Professor nas suas atividades de ensino em geral, ajudando-o a manter a atenção dos alunos durante as aulas.
  • Abordar os alunos individualmente durante o horário de aula, esclarecendo dúvidas e auxiliando o Professor na condução da turma.
  • Auxiliar os novos alunos no processo de adaptação à Escola.
  • Monitorar os alunos nos horários de intervalos para lanche e refeição, mantendo a higiene e limpeza do local e certificando-se que estejam se alimentando adequadamente.
  • Supervisionar os alunos durante as atividades do playground, planejando juntamente com o professor essas respectivas atividades.
  • Supervisionar os alunos quando vão ao banheiro, orientando-os com relação aos procedimentos de higiene.
  • Acompanhar os alunos nas atividades extracurriculares, bem como as ligadas a Artes/Corpo & Movimento.
  • Acompanhar as discussões e disputas entre os alunos, intervindo quando necessário, a fim de promover um ambiente de harmonia, amizade e respeito.
  • Substituir eventualmente o professor quando da sua ausência da sala de aula.
  • Verificar diariamente a agenda de cada aluno observando as anotações, recados e outras informações pertinentes.
  • Executar a posologia de medicamentos prescritos aos alunos, quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os alunos em atividades externas promovidas pela Escola, tais como, visitas de estudos, viagens, passeios etc.
  • Contribuir com o Professor no processo de alfabetização dos alunos em idioma inglês.
  • Assistir o professor na condução da turma em sala de aula, auxiliando-o na aplicação de medidas disciplinares necessárias ao processo de ensino/aprendizagem dos alunos.
  • Ajudar a avaliar o desempenho dos alunos com relação aos deveres e exercícios, observando seus respectivos cadernos.
  • Auxiliar o Professor continuamente, na avaliação do desenvolvimento individual de cada aluno em todas as áreas do Curriculo Escolar.
  • Cuidar do desenvolvimento das atitudes e comportamentos dos alunos, expressos no “Perfil do Estudante – PYP”.
  • Discutir com o Professor as atividades a serem aplicadas, de forma que estas reforcem os comportamentos e atitudes previstas no PYP.
  • Participais de reuniões semanais de planejamento, com Professores e Coordenador Pedagógico, submetendo-se às orientações relativas a dinâmica de trabalho, conteúdo, estratégias, atitudes, etc.
  • Organizar os espaços, brinquedos, recursos audiovisuais e outros materiais a serem utilizados em sala de aula.
  • Requisitar pequenos reparos ou consertos à equipe de manutenção, visando a disponibilidade dos materiais, equipamentos e instalações do ambiente de aula.
  • Checar a frequência diária dos alunos em classe, lançando as informações em relatório específico e encaminhando-o à Secretaria da Escola.
  • Auxiliar na organização e participar dos eventos escolares com pais, alunos e professores, tais como “open house”, dia das mães, dia dos pais, de Ação de Graças, encerramento de ano e outros previamente definidos pela Escola.
  • Organizar as pastas individuais dos alunos, que constituem as atividades dos mesmos durante o ano letivo, bem como, montar o Yearbook individual para entrega a cada aluno no encerramento do ano.
  • Auxiliar o Professor na edição e formatação dos Reports individuais, documentando o processo de desenvolvimento do aluno.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

FORMAÇÃO: Ensino Superior em Pedagogia

IMPORTANTE: Experiência em escolas bilíngues. Conhecimento do currículo PYP / IB ou em PBL.

title: Sr Product Owner
description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United Stat.


Summary

Responsible for software development projects for payment terminals and embedded media for Latin America.


Detailed Description Of The Activities

  • Rapid understanding and development of new functions in the payment software platform, DFS embedded media products.
  • Represent stakeholders during the project and monitor projects with customers (internal and/or external).
  • Organize and plan the product backlog, conducting meetings with stakeholders to prioritize the items to be developed whenever necessary.
  • Responsible for the decisions of which teamwork will maximize the value of the product and add more to those involved, sets goals, prioritizes and approves quality, always seeking to ensure the highest return on investment.
  • Maintain the agile management principles followed by the team, supporting the Scrum processes with the team (daily, planning, review and retrospective), Kanban and other applicable methods.
  • Assist the commercial teams in the presentation of existing or new products, understanding of new demands and support in the generation of commercial proposals for specific new projects or improvements in existing projects, and should support the other areas of the company in the preparation of equipment and specific versions for demonstrations, fairs and presentations.
  • Prepare reports so that everyone is aligned on the status of developments, according to the processes and frameworks used by DFS for project management and new product development.
  • Coordinate SW releases to the field and provide support afterwards.
  • Train internal and external support teams, as well as DFS manufacturing areas in new products or versions that generate significant changes.
  • Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
  • Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
  • Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.
  • Monitor and support internal and external audit processes (ISO).
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


Instruction

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.


Specific Knowledge

  • Advanced/fluent English and Spanish;
  • Programming language: C# and XML;
  • Knowledge of cryptography;
  • Device connection (TCP, Serial, etc);
  • Knowledge of network (wired, wireless, routers, etc.);
  • Domain in Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Desirable

  • Development and integrations of payment methods -
  • Jira;
  • TeamCity;
  • GITHub;
  • Confluence;
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc;.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

● Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D): Conduzir análises exploratórias complexas e desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos para resolver desafios de negócio, desde a otimização de processos até a criação de novos produtos.

● Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

● Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

● Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA, configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

● Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

● Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.


Diferenciais:

● Experiência com dados de IoT (Internet das Coisas), especialmente em ambientes industriais ou de manufatura.

● Conhecimento em mais de uma plataforma de cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).

● Experiência prévia no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: mineração, finanças, varejo).

● Contribuições para a comunidade de tecnologia (ex: projetos open-source no GitHub, artigos em blogs, palestras em eventos).

Certificações

Certificação: Apresentar pelo menos uma certificação relevante em cloud ou dados (ex: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate).


Formação e Experiência Mínima:

● Formação Acadêmica: Formação superior completa em Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Cursos de curta duração ou majoritariamente online não serão considerados como formação principal.

● Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência comprovada atuando diretamente com análise de dados, desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning e projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente corporativo.

● Estabilidade Profissional: Histórico com permanência média de 2 anos nas últimas experiências profissionais, demonstrando consistência e desenvolvimento de carreira.

● Inglês avançado/fluente para colaboração com times globais.


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills):

● Linguagens e Ferramentas: Proficiência em Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

● Machine Learning e Deep Learning: Sólida experiência com bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch e Keras. Conhecimento prático em técnicas de regressão, classificação, clusterização, séries temporais, Text Analytics (NLP) e visão computacional.

● Plataformas de Cloud: Experiência hands-on com serviços de IA em nuvem, especialmente Azure Machine Learning. Conhecimento em Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics e/ou serviços equivalentes em AWS ou GCP é um diferencial.

● Bancos de Dados e Big Data: Domínio de estruturas de bancos de dados (Relacional e NoSQL), linguagem SQL e experiência com tecnologias de Big Data como Hadoop, Spark ou MapReduce.

● MLOps e Governança: Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para IA (MLOps), incluindo versionamento de código (Git), CI/CD para modelos e monitoramento da performance em produção. Familiaridade com frameworks de governança corporativa de IA.

● Visualização de Dados: Habilidade para criar dashboards e relatórios interativos utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou bibliotecas como Matplotlib e Seaborn.


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

● Pensamento Analítico e Resolução de Problemas: Perfil investigativo, proativo e com alta capacidade para decompor problemas complexos e propor soluções eficazes.

● Comunicação e Influência: Excelente habilidade de comunicação para dialogar com diferentes níveis da organização, desde equipes técnicas até executivos, e capacidade de "traduzir" dados em insights de negócio.

● Visão de Negócio: Capacidade de entender os objetivos estratégicos da empresa e conectar os projetos de Ciência de Dados a resultados de negócio mensuráveis.

● Colaboração e Trabalho em Equipe: Atitude colaborativa para trabalhar em squads multidisciplinares, compartilhando conhecimento e construindo soluções em conjunto.

● Inovação e Criatividade: Curiosidade intelectual e habilidade para "pensar fora da caixa", desafiando o status quo e propondo abordagens inovadoras.

description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!


Por que entrar na TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, é por isso que vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria, e desenvolvimento mútuo.
